card.summary: 5 GB storage on Free (unlimited on Twist Unlimited); 100 MB per attachment

free_tier.stated: 5 GB storage on Free (unlimited on Twist Unlimited); 100 MB per attachment

egress.terms: Free; files served from Twist's own storage

record.tooling: Twist has an API but no documented bulk file-upload surface and no rclone backend; wrapper-only
record.chaining: 5 GB x N free teams. Twist free teams are unlimited in number from one account ('create a separate, free team'), so it chains - but 5 GB/team means ~100 teams for 500 GB.
record.limits_note: 5 GB per team; 100 MB per attachment; 10 MB for emailed attachments; thread history older than one month is not viewable on Free (data retained server-side, not deleted)
record.reliability_note: Distinctive upside: Twist explicitly never deletes data on the Free plan - the one-month limit is visibility only. That makes it a rare non-hostile free tier, just a small one.

evidence.proved: 'There is a 100MB file size limit for attachments'; 'When using the Free plan of Twist, the storage limit is 5GB'
'all your team's data will still be safely stored on our servers - nothing will ever be deleted'

card.summary: 5 GB of file storage per team on Free; unlimited on Twist Unlimited. 100 MB per attachment.

free_tier.stated: 5 GB of file storage per team on Free; unlimited on Twist Unlimited. 100 MB per attachment.

record.tooling: Twist REST API (api.twist.com/api/v3) with attachment upload by `file_id`; OAuth2 app registration. Weaker client ecosystem than Slack.
record.chaining: Unlimited free teams per account ('create a separate, free team'), so N teams x 5 GB is trivially repeatable. But each team needs its own members/invites.
record.limits_note: 5 GB/team; 100 MB/attachment; 10 MB for emailed attachments; free-plan thread history older than one month is not viewable (though Twist explicitly retains it server-side and never deletes).
record.reliability_note: No deletion stated ('nothing will ever be deleted'), which is unusual and good. The 5 GB cap is the wall.

evidence.proved: 'There is a 100MB file size limit for attachments'; 'When using the Free plan of Twist, the storage limit is 5GB.'
'all your team's data will still be safely stored on our servers – nothing will ever be deleted'
